verdict.rationale: Docs show Adyen Issuing can create Visa/Mastercard virtual and physical cards backed by a balance account, with flexible pooled or per-card funding (a debit/prepaid-style model), but there is no explicit mention of commercial credit or consumer credit card programs, credit lines, or interest/repayment mechanics anywhere in the evidence pack. missing for 10: explicit support for commercial credit programs, consumer credit programs, credit limits/lines, or revolving credit functionality.
